Data Practices
Request Government Data
1. Complete the following required forms:
Washington County Request for Nonpublic Data (PDF)
Informed Consent for the Release of Data (PDF)
2. Email completed forms to WCA-datapractices@WashingtonCountyMN.gov.
Email Staff
Minnesota Government Data Practices Act (MGDPA)
Regulates the management of government data that is collected, created, received, or released by a governmental entity.
Requires the county to prepare and post a list of the records or forms that include private or confidential data on individuals.
Washington County Data Practices Policy (PDF)

AI Chatbot Terms of Use
Your use of the Washington County AI chatbot tool is entirely voluntary. This chatbot is not the exclusive source of county information. If you require verified information or wish to conduct official business, you may contact the appropriate county department directly via phone, email, or in-person visit during standard business hours. By electing to use the Washington County AI Chatbot, you acknowledge that you are interacting with an automated system and agree to the following terms:
Public Data: Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act (MGDPA) and other applicable public records laws, any information, questions, or prompts you enter into this chatbot are considered public data. These records may be subject to inspection and copying by the public upon request. Do not share any sensitive or nonpublic data in the AI chatbot tool. Any data you enter into the AI chatbot tool may be treated as public data by Washington County.
No Warranty & Disclaimer of Accuracy: This tool is provided for your convenience as a preliminary information resource only. AI technology may generate incorrect, misleading, or biased information. Washington County does not warrant that the chatbot’s responses are accurate, complete, current, or reliable. The chatbot’s output does not constitute legal, medical, financial, or professional advice and is not an official statement of county policy or law.
Limitation of Liability: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Washington County, its officials, and its employees are not liable for any actions taken, or decisions made, in reliance on the information provided by the chatbot. By using this tool, you agree to waive any and all claims against the county arising from the use of, or inability to use, this service.
